title: DiceBear — MIT avatar library with 61 deterministic seedable styles
summary: Open-source MIT avatar library with 61 styles: deterministic profile pictures from a seed via HTTP API, language SDKs, CLI, visual editor, and a Figma-to-JSON custom-style pipeline for profiles, chat, and placeholders.
question_it_answers: How do you ship deterministic seeded avatars without storing user photos?

claims.text: The HTTP API serves deterministic avatars from a style and seed at api.dicebear.com/10.x/{style}/{format}.
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion

claims.text: Custom styles can be designed in Figma with DiceBear naming conventions and exported via the Studio plugin to JSON.
claims.evidence: Design components in Figma with DiceBear naming conventions
claims.subject: landing-ui-motion
